titles.title: GRID Savings Act of 2026
GRID Savings Act of 2026
Guarding Ratepayers from Increased Demand-costs Savings Act of 2026

A bill to amend the Federal Power Act to clarify the jurisdiction of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission over the interconnection of large loads to the transmission system, to provide for standards and procedures for the interconnection of large loads, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
